spec.name: uk_ani_pension_target_2026_27
spec.summary: UK 2026-27: how much to pay (net) into a relief-at-source personal pension to bring adjusted net income down to a limit. Targets: personal_allowance_taper (GBP 100,000), child_benefit_charge_nil (GBP 60,000), tax_free_childcare (limit not served by any skill: always returns missing_rule until a skill serves it).

rules.name: PA_TAPER_START
rules.quote: Personal Allowance taper (ITA 2007 s.35(2)) | Reduced by half the adjusted net income over GBP 100,000

rules.name: HICBC_START
rules.quote: High Income Child Benefit Charge (ITEPA 2003 s.681C) | 1% of Child Benefit per GBP 200 of adjusted net income over GBP 60,000; 100% at GBP 80,000
